annotations.title: Gross Domestic Regeneration (GDR) — An Emerging Economic Model

description: A 2026 proposal, not institutionally adopted, to measure an economy by what it regenerates (ecological, social and capital dimensions) rather than what it produces. Presented as an unvalidated framework alongside established 'beyond GDP' precedents: Bhutan's Gross National Happiness Index, the UN SEEA Ecosystem Accounting standard, state-level Genuine Progress Indicators and Doughnut Economics.
